external_dependencies_top10.purpose: Zero runtime dependencies — CLAUDE.md: 'Superpowers is a zero-dependency plugin by design'

entry_points.notes: 'NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST' — the Iron Law

capabilities.name: Red/Green/Refactor TDD enforcement (Iron Law)
capabilities.description: Explicit 'NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST' rule; Watch-fail → minimal code → watch-pass cycle mandatory; 'Code before test? Delete it. Start over.'

capabilities.name: Testing anti-patterns reference
capabilities.description: Common TDD pitfalls (mock-only tests, test-only methods, mocking without understanding deps)

capabilities.name: Brainstorming → spec extraction (Socratic)
capabilities.description: Teases spec from conversation, presents design in chunks short enough to read, waits for sign-off

capabilities.name: Writing plans with bite-sized tasks
capabilities.description: Plans target 2–5-min tasks, exact file paths, complete code, verification steps; 'No placeholders' rule (TBD/TODO/'similar to Task N' are plan failures)

capabilities.name: Subagent-driven development with two-stage review
capabilities.description: Fresh subagent per task; spec-compliance review THEN code-quality review; explicit DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS/NEEDS_CONTEXT/BLOCKED status handling

capabilities.name: Executing plans (batched + checkpoints)
capabilities.description: Alternative to subagent-driven for parallel sessions

capabilities.name: Git worktrees for isolated workspace
capabilities.description: Mandatory isolated workspace on new branch before implementation

capabilities.name: Verification before completion
capabilities.description: Ensures fix is actually fixed before claiming done

capabilities.name: Requesting / receiving code review
capabilities.description: Pre-review checklist + feedback loop; code-reviewer agent

capabilities.name: Writing skills (meta)
capabilities.description: Creating new skills with testing methodology

capabilities.name: Skill auto-triggering on context
capabilities.description: 'The skills trigger automatically' — session-start hook + skill discovery ensure mandatory workflows activate without user prompting

capabilities.name: Cross-harness plugin packaging
capabilities.description: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot — shipped as plugin across 6 harnesses

capabilities.name: Zero-dependency design
capabilities.description: Explicitly 'zero-dependency plugin by design' — PRs adding third-party deps rejected

plugins.mechanism: Superpowers IS the plugin; extension is via 'writing-skills' in a separate plugin

unique_selling_points: TDD is not recommended — it is enforced (the Iron Law; delete code written before tests)
Subagent-driven development with fresh context per task + TWO-stage review (spec compliance THEN code quality)
Skills auto-trigger — user does not need to remember to invoke them
Published to Claude Code official marketplace

limitations.description: No structured executable-spec format — spec emerges from brainstorming dialogue, saved as a design document, not a typed artefact with IDs
limitations.source: README.md (spec 'teased out of conversation'); no spec-template.md

limitations.description: No drift detection / roundtripping — once a plan is executed, there is no explicit artifact that tracks spec↔code divergence
Narrow command surface (3 slash commands) — methodology relies on auto-triggering vs explicit commands
Strict PR policy: 94% rejection rate for external PRs; contributors shaped by CLAUDE.md
